instruction: Log actual optional acquisition and source choices; do not replace task-bound gateway session

actions.query: HbA1c nondiabetic fasting glucose BMI multivariable coefficient
actions.purpose: Find a directly reported HbA1c-glucose or BMI coefficient after age/sex/BMI/glucose adjustment for the missing Q3 relationship.
actions.decision: Returned accepted metadata were dominated by diabetes case-control/complication studies; no directly usable missing adjusted relationship was identified. No original article fetched, and no metadata statistic enters the model.

actions.query: TITLE:(HbA1c OR glycated haemoglobin OR glycated hemoglobin) AND TITLE:(determinants OR factors) AND (nondiabetic OR non-diabetic) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1990-01-01 TO 2020-12-31]
actions.purpose: Narrow the same missing adjusted-relationship search toward HbA1c determinants in non-diabetic adults.
actions.decision: Screened returned titles/abstracts. Genetics, diabetic treatment and pediatric reports do not supply the needed adult adjusted coefficient. The older-adult report PMC3395860 includes ages65-95 and mixed glycemic status; its abstract does not report a usable fasting-glucose-adjusted BMI effect. No download or quantitative use.

actions.query: TITLE_ABS:(nonglycemic OR non-glycemic) AND TITLE_ABS:(HbA1c OR glycated hemoglobin) AND FIRST_PDATE:[1990-01-01 TO 2020-12-31]
actions.purpose: Look for nonglycemic HbA1c determinants that could directly identify the glucose-adjusted BMI component.
actions.decision: Screened returned metadata include diabetic kinetic models, albumin/genetics, clinical disease or treatment contexts. No directly usable new Q3 coefficient identified. No download or source-model statistic taken from search metadata. This was a limited search, not a claim of literature exhaustion.

source_choices.choice: Use NHANES adjusted age slope, BMI mean, and age50-54 HbA1c mean/quantile with explicit transport and approximate dispersion derivation; preserve FOS/other-age observations as context/checks. Do not treat tiny prose +/- values or Table1 SEs as residual SDs.

Use Finnish general-population continuous-BMI S1/S2 coefficients. Select admitted supplement text894ba816... corroborated by page-oriented480cb548...; both are the same source. Retain fasting-adjustment ambiguity and stricter HbA1c/diabetes exclusions.

Use reported marginal Pearson r0.23, BMI SD3.8, glucose mean91.2 and SD12.4 under named transport assumptions. Decline Table2 printed regression slopes because their raw-unit relation to r and SDs is unresolved; do not silently repair their scale. HbA1c mean/SD and BMI mean are not transferred.
Read Methods and Tables1,3-6 for age/sex heterogeneity and selection limitations; contextual/check-only role, no fitted numerical parameter.

calculation_record.scope: Deterministic proposed-law moments and support feasibility; no individual rows, random draws or generator execution. Not target validation.
